# Imposia 0.9.0

Imposia 0.9.0 accepts SVG images. A document that references an SVG through
`<img>` or CSS `url()` now shows it instead of reporting it as an unsupported
type. Every other default is unchanged, and there is no migration note.

## Highlights

- **SVG as an image.** `image/svg+xml` joins the image allowlist for resolver
  results. The file must be well-formed, have an `svg` root, and decode the way
  it is drawn.
- **Refuse, never repair.** Scripts, `foreignObject`, embedded frames or media,
  event-handler attributes, entity declarations, `@import`, and any `href` or
  `url()` that leaves the file are refused. A refusal is a `RESOURCE_BLOCKED`
  warning naming the element and the reason, with nothing quoted from the file.
- **Parsed, not pattern-matched.** CSS in `style` attributes and `<style>`
  elements is parsed, so escaped spellings such as `u\72l(` are seen, and plain
  descriptive text such as an `aria-label` mentioning `@import` is never read as
  CSS. XLink references are checked by namespace, whatever prefix is bound.
- **Same result everywhere.** The preview and the standalone HTML export keep the
  authored display size and aspect ratio; the export inlines the SVG as a data URL.

## Upgrade

Update all four packages together:

```sh
npm install @imposia/core@0.9.0 @imposia/viewer@0.9.0 @imposia/client@0.9.0 @imposia/react@0.9.0
```
